CustomField.description: When checked, PDF uses Named Credential DocEngine_Pdf → DocEngine.pro POST /api/v1/render/pdf. When unchecked, Salesforce Blob.toPdf (HTML→PDF).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Off = Salesforce HTML→PDF (no host). On = Named Credential DocEngine_Pdf → DocEngine.pro /api/v1/render/pdf (API token as password).
CustomField.label: Use External PDF
